topic: how McDonalds makes about two fifths of its revenue from rent paid by its franchisees
storyAngle: McDonalds is closer to a landlord than a burger chain.
doNotClaim: Rent is the 10-K "Rents" revenue line, not profit.
Do not say McDonalds owns every restaurant.

facts.claim: McDonalds 2024 RENT revenue from franchisees was $10,017 million.
facts.note: two independent excerpts agreed; confirm in 10-K before long-form use

facts.claim: About 95% of McDonalds restaurants worldwide are franchised.

derived.claim: Rent was about 39% of total revenue (10,017 / 25,920): nearly two fifths.
